source: Mordheim rulebook — Leadership & Psychology, Shooting, and the warband lists
notes: Special rules shared by more than one warband. A unit refers to one by {"ref": "<id>"}, optionally with `params` to fill a placeholder and `note` for a warband-specific rider. Rules unique to one unit stay inline on that unit as {"name", "description"}.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: Any warrior within {range} of this model may use his Leadership characteristic when taking Leadership tests.

fear.name: Fear
fear.description: This model causes fear. See the Leadership & Psychology rules.

largeTarget.name: Large Target
largeTarget.description: This model is a Large Target: it may be picked out and shot at even when it is not the closest model. See the Shooting rules.

stupidity.name: Stupidity
stupidity.description: This model is subject to Stupidity and must test at the start of each of its own turns. See the Leadership & Psychology rules.

immuneToPsychology.name: Immune to Psychology
immuneToPsychology.description: This model is immune to psychology: it never takes fear, terror, all alone or rout-related Leadership tests, and never leaves close combat.

animal.name: Animal
animal.description: This model is an animal and never gains Experience.

animosity.name: Animosity
animosity.description: At the start of each of the player’s own turns, roll a D6 for this warrior. On a 1 he has taken offence at something one of his mates has done or said; roll again on the Animosity chart for the effect.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Whenever this model suffers a wound, roll a D6: on a 4 or more the wound is ignored and the model is unhurt. Wounds caused by fire or fire-based magic may not be regenerated.

dumbMonster.name: Dumb Monster
dumbMonster.description: This model is far too stupid to learn anything: it never gains Experience and may not take skills.

expertSwordsmen.name: Expert Swordsmen
expertSwordsmen.description: May re-roll failed hits when charging, but only when armed with a normal sword — not a double-handed sword or any other weapon.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.description: This model is a wizard and may cast spells from its list. Its spells are shown on its own entry.

prayers.name: Prayers
prayers.description: This model is a priest and may use prayers from its list. Prayers are not spells, so protection against spells does not affect them. Its prayers are shown on its own entry.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.description: Hard to Kill: only taken Out of Action on a roll of 6 on the Injury chart, not 5-6 (1-2 Knocked Down, 3-5 Stunned, 6 Out of Action). Hard Head: ignores the special rules for maces, clubs, etc.

slayer.name: Slayer
slayer.description: Deathwish: immune to all psychology (including Hatred, Frenzy and Stupidity) and never tests for fighting alone. Damnable Luck: once per post-game, one Death result for a Slayer may be re-rolled. No Armour No Toys: may never use armour or cloaks that give a constant save bonus (Lucky Charms are allowed), no missile weapons that aren't thrown, and may not learn magic. See the warband's special rules for Only in Victory and Record of Valor.

hatred.name: Hatred
hatred.description: This model hates {target}. See the Leadership & Psychology rules.

skittish.name: Skittish
skittish.description: As newly crowned Slayers, these warriors do not have Deathwish and suffer psychology like normal. When one gains 'That Lad's Got Talent', instead of making an immediate roll on the Hero Advance table, he must learn the skill Deathwish.
